title: Emerald Armor
description: Adds Emerald Armor, Tools And Weapons!
body:
Emerald Gear

Emerald Gear is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly Minecraft mod that introduces a complete set of Emerald tools, weapons, and armor. Instead of letting your emeralds sit in chests or be used only for trading, you can now craft powerful equipment and gain unique trading benefits.

Designed to fit naturally into Minecraft, Emerald Gear provides a balanced progression without disrupting the vanilla experience.

Features
Complete Emerald Equipment Set

Craft an entire collection of emerald gear:

🗡️ Emerald Sword
⛏️ Emerald Pickaxe
🪓 Emerald Axe
🥄 Emerald Shovel
🌾 Emerald Hoe
⛑️ Emerald Helmet
🛡️ Emerald Chestplate
👖 Emerald Leggings
👢 Emerald Boots
Unique Armor Bonus

Emerald armor isn't just for protection—it also improves your relationship with villagers.

Each piece of Emerald Armor you wear reduces villager trade costs by 1 emerald.

💚 1 armor piece = 1 Emerald discount
💚 2 armor pieces = 2 Emerald discount
💚 3 armor pieces = 3 Emerald discount
💚 4 armor pieces = 4 Emerald discount

When wearing the full Emerald Armor set, you receive an additional set bonus:

✨ Full Set Bonus: 5 Emerald Discount

This makes Emerald Gear especially valuable for players who rely on villager trading and large trading halls.

Balanced Gameplay

Emerald Gear is carefully balanced to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft.

Vanilla-friendly progression
Perfect for Survival worlds and SMP servers
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Gives emeralds a meaningful new purpose
Why Emerald Gear?
Adds a complete Emerald equipment set.
Makes emeralds useful beyond villager trading.
Rewards players who invest in Emerald Armor.
Encourages building villager trading halls.
Fits seamlessly into the Minecraft experience.
Perfect For
Survival Players
Multiplayer Servers (SMP)
Economy-Based Servers
Vanilla+ Modpacks
Players who love villager trading

Wear Emerald Gear, save emeralds on every trade, and become the richest trader in your world! 💚
